text.p: The following are some leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
* Portugal has practically assured that it will continue to receive structural funds from the European Union after 2000, the paper says citing various unnamed senior European Commission officials.

* The Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco told parliament that a controversial system of VAT collection for small businesses, which has been temporarily suspended, will be reintroduced for the 1998 budget.

* Portuguese government plans to fight European Commission veto on 30 billion escudos of guarantees given to state cereals company EPAC, newspaper quotes deputy finance minister Fernando Teixeira dos Santos as saying.
